flags.label: Auto overtime split
flags.desc: Split hours past the weekly threshold into an overtime pay code.

flags.label: Late finish detection
flags.desc: Flag shifts finishing after the configured cut-off.

flags.label: Unsocial hours detection
flags.desc: Flag hours worked inside the unsocial window.

flags.label: Email approval
flags.desc: Managers can approve a week from an email link.

flags.label: Show indicative pay to employees
flags.desc: Off by default — rates stay in Business Central.

flags.label: Vehicle & movement fields
flags.desc: Offered to employee types with the vehicle capability.

flags.label: Project & costing fields
flags.desc: Project, task, cost centre and billable flag.

flags.label: Shift & rota fields
flags.desc: Rota line on the entry, and shift premium rules.

flags.label: Break tracking
flags.desc: Employees record unpaid breaks; deducted from net hours.

flags.label: Right to work
flags.desc: Collect proof of the right to work, with the document type declared.

flags.label: Convictions declaration
flags.desc: Ask whether the person has unspent convictions, with detail where they do.

flags.label: Working time opt-out
flags.desc: Record whether the person opts out of the 48-hour weekly limit.

flags.label: Qualifications
flags.desc: Collect qualifications and certificates, with expiry where relevant.

flags.label: Policy acknowledgement
flags.desc: Require each policy to be read and acknowledged before submission.

flags.label: Signature on sign-off
flags.desc: Capture a drawn signature rather than a tick alone.

flags.label: Document verification
flags.desc: A named person checks each uploaded document before it counts.

flags.label: Employee portal
flags.desc: Handbook, company information, vacancies and benefits for people already working.

flags.label: Document centre
flags.desc: Shared documents in Employee Self-Service.

flags.label: Notice board
flags.desc: Managers post to their location, admins to everyone. Colleagues read, and acknowledge where asked.

flags.label: Self-service profile changes
flags.desc: Colleagues propose changes to their own contact, emergency and bank details. Every change is approved before it takes effect.

flags.label: Daily entry
flags.desc: The day form.

flags.label: Weekly grid
flags.desc: Seven-day grid capture.

flags.label: Multi-week submit
flags.desc: Catch up on earlier unsubmitted weeks in one action.

flags.label: Location check on clock
flags.desc: Capture coordinates when a shift starts.

flags.label: Geofence radius per site
flags.desc: Warn when a clock-in falls outside the site radius.

flags.label: Working patterns
flags.desc: Generate the rota from repeating cycles up to the configured horizon.

flags.label: Minimum staffing
flags.desc: Coverage is checked against each location’s support level.

flags.label: Shift fulfilment workflow
flags.desc: Timed, staged cover requests with escalation.

flags.label: Safe-worker filtering
flags.desc: Only advertise work to people who are cleared and eligible.

flags.label: Flexible worker monitoring
flags.desc: Count bank weeks and notify HR at the configured milestones.

flags.label: IT access request on fulfilment
flags.desc: Raise a site-access request when a shift is filled.

flags.label: Minimum rest checking
flags.desc: Warn when two shifts leave less than the configured rest.

flags.label: Worker shift preferences
flags.desc: Employees choose where and when they want to be offered work.

flags.label: Automatic entitlement calculation
flags.desc: Derive annual leave from hours, pattern and service.

flags.label: Pro-rata recalculation
flags.desc: Recalculate entitlement when working arrangements change.

flags.label: Leaver reconciliation
flags.desc: Settle over- or under-taken leave at the leaving date.

flags.label: Approval SLA & escalation
flags.desc: Escalate a request that is not decided within the SLA.

flags.label: Leave affects rota availability
flags.desc: Approved leave removes the person from rota allocation.

flags.label: Time off in lieu
flags.desc: Accrue and spend TOIL within the configured window.

modules.name: Workforce core
modules.desc: People, employee types, approvals, notifications and the Business Central hand-off.

modules.name: Timesheet
modules.desc: How time is captured, checked and sent for approval.

modules.name: Rota
modules.desc: Shift catalogue, working patterns, coverage and the shift fulfilment workflow.

modules.name: Leave & absence
modules.desc: Leave types, entitlement, booking workflow and leaver reconciliation.

modules.name: Onboarding
modules.desc: What a new starter completes before their first day, and what the business checks before they can work.

permGroups.label: Their own work
permGroups.desc: Every persona is an employee record first, so these apply to everyone.

permGroups.label: Their team
permGroups.desc: Scoped by department and location — never organisation-wide unless master data is granted.

permGroups.label: Configuration
permGroups.desc: How this workforce operates. Normally admin only.

candidate.label: Candidate
candidate.note: Offered a role, not yet set up. No access, no rota, no timesheet.

preboard.label: Preboarding
preboard.note: Being set up — compliance and access in progress. Not yet rota’d.

active.label: Active
active.note: Working. Appears on the rota, submits time, counts toward coverage.

suspended.label: Suspended
suspended.note: Not to be offered shifts. Existing timesheets stand and still need approving.

onleave.label: On long leave
onleave.note: Away for an extended period — maternity, sabbatical, long-term sick.

leaver.label: Leaver
leaver.note: Leaving date set. Entitlement is reconciled and future shifts are released.

archived.label: Archived
archived.note: Kept for audit and payroll history. Hidden from every working list.

typeCapabilities.label: Vehicles & driving
typeCapabilities.desc: Offers vehicle registrations, movements, drive time and co-driver.

typeCapabilities.label: Site & location
typeCapabilities.desc: Offers the location field and per-site rules. Needs the Sites module.

typeCapabilities.label: Project & costing
typeCapabilities.desc: Offers project, task, cost centre and the billable flag.

typeCapabilities.label: Shift & rota
typeCapabilities.desc: Offers the rota-line field and shift-premium rules.

selfFields.label: Mobile number
selfFields.hint: Used for shift offers and urgent cover

selfFields.label: Home address
selfFields.hint: Kept for payroll and statutory documents

selfFields.label: Emergency contact
selfFields.hint: Who we call if something happens on shift

selfFields.hint: Verified by payroll before it takes effect — never used by Workforce itself
